description: Docker-powered local Markdown notes server launcher; not a native Windows app.
notes: Requires Docker Desktop with Linux containers and a running Docker Engine. Scoop installs only this launcher; it does not install Docker.
The upstream documentation says Windows is not supported. This is an unofficial Docker Desktop/Linux-container workaround and is not an upstream-supported Windows installation.
Run note-mark or note-mark open to start the service at http://localhost:8181. Use note-mark stop, note-mark logs, or note-mark status to manage it.

The container uses the versioned ghcr.io/enchant97/note-mark image and a Docker named volume for notes. A random authentication secret is saved under Scoop's persistent data folder. Uninstalling removes the container but retains the data volume and secret.

script: try { & "$dir\note-mark.ps1" remove } catch { warn "Note Mark container removal could not be completed; remove it manually if Docker is unavailable." }
